title: Plural Voices, Single Agent: Towards Inclusive AI in Multi-User Domestic Spaces

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness (using disparate impact ratio) and user adaptation by testing the model's responses to concurrent domestic queries from users of different age groups (children, typical adults, and the elderly), ensuring the system does not unfairly prioritize or ignore specific age demographics.

Assessing fairness disparities and cognitive accessibility by simulating multi-user conflicts and measuring the model's ability to adapt its tone, clarity, and safety parameters for neurodivergent users (e.g., individuals with autism or ADHD) compared to neurotypical users.
